description: This file defines the Category model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, including methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving category data, as well as managing category paths, filters, stores, layouts, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Model class for managing categories in Opencart, including CRUD operations, path management, filters, store associations, layouts, and SEO URL handling.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category record in the database, including descriptions, paths, filters, store associations, SEO URLs, and layout settings.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category record, including descriptions, paths, SEO URLs, filters, store associations, and layouts.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a category.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category and all related data such as descriptions, paths, filters, store associations, layouts, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: Repairs category paths and hierarchy, fixing any inconsistencies.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific category.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories based on optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCategories
methods.description: Returns the total count of categories matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a category in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific category.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for categories in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific category.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for categories in a specific language.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a path record linking a category to its parent in the hierarchy.

methods.name: deletePaths
methods.description: Deletes all path records for a specific category.

methods.name: deletePathsByLevel
methods.description: Deletes path records for a category below a certain hierarchy level.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the full path string of a category based on its hierarchy.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves all path records for a specific category.

methods.name: getPathsByPathId
methods.description: Retrieves path records by path ID.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Associates a filter with a category.

methods.name: deleteFilters
methods.description: Removes all filters associated with a category.

methods.name: deleteFiltersByFilterId
methods.description: Removes filter associations by filter ID.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves all filter IDs associated with a category.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a category with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes store associations for a category.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all category-store associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with a category.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a layout with a category for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for a category.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Removes all category-layout associations for a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all category-layout associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout IDs associated with a category for each store.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many categories are associated with a specific layout.
